title: Different Approaches to AI
introduction: AI is a broad field containing approaches that can be used separately or combined.
learningOutcomes: Describe rule-based systems, machine learning, deep learning and generative AI.
Choose an appropriate description for a simple system.

activities.question: Put these categories in order from broader field to more specific technique.
activities.explanation: Machine learning is an approach within AI, and deep learning is a family of machine-learning techniques.

activities.question: A support system follows explicit if–then instructions written by an expert. What is the best description?
activities.explanation: Rule-based systems apply knowledge encoded as explicit logical rules.

activities.question: Generative AI and deep learning always mean exactly the same thing.
activities.explanation: Many generative systems use deep learning, but deep learning also supports non-generative tasks such as classification.
